articles.title: US Attacks Iranian Port Using Sea Drones for the First Time
articles.summary: US forces deployed armed sea drones in combat for the first time, striking a submarine and ship maintenance facility at Iran's Bandar Abbas naval base. This development, confirmed by the Pentagon, signifies a new era in naval warfare technology and showcases advanced unmanned system capabilities. For SSB aspirants, this highlights evolving military strategies, the integration of cutting-edge tech in defense, and geopolitical implications concerning US-Iran dynamics.

articles.title: 5 Terrifying DC Heroes’ Rogues Galleries (and #2’s Could Destroy the Multiverse)
articles.summary: The article highlights that DC Comics' heroes achieve their remarkable stature primarily due to the exceptional quality of their villains. It emphasizes DC's prowess in creating the most significant antagonists in comic book history, asserting that these compelling foes are fundamental to defining the strength, challenges, and narrative depth of their heroic counterparts. This symbiotic dynamic between iconic heroes and their equally iconic villains is presented as a cornerstone of DC's enduring legacy and narrative success.
